title: mime-tree: InlineUUBlock and InlineYEncBlock missing Serialize + Deserialize
description: Both InlineUUBlock (uuencode.rs:49) and InlineYEncBlock (yenc.rs:60) are publicly exported types. The workspace invariant (AGENTS.md) states all public types must impl Serialize + Deserialize. Both only derive Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq — no serde derives. ParseError (error.rs:7) has the same gap. Fix: add #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] to all three types.
